title: Study in the UK: The Student Playbook
subtitle: Admissions, funding, visas and student life in the United Kingdom
description:
The complete student playbook for studying in the United Kingdom, written for readers coming from Africa and anywhere else in the world.

Choose a course and a city, build an application and a funding plan, prepare the Student visa step by step (money rules, the 28-day funds period, English, TB and ATAS, the genuine student check), plan your flight, phone and budget, find a home and settle in, then get through teaching, academic integrity, work limits, health care and safety. The last part covers the Graduate Route and other ways to stay, going home well, and a toolkit with a calendar, checklists, letter templates, an official directory and a glossary.

Every figure carries the date it was checked, unconfirmed facts are marked, and the book is illustrated with real photographs.

General information, not legal, immigration or financial advice.
